title: Points earned
description: An order earned points for a member. `points` is what this event granted, `debtRepaid` is the part of it that repaid an existing debt instead of creating a new lot, and `available` and `debt` are the member's balances after the change. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member.

orderRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the order that earned, so the event matches the order the Tenant sent.

points.description: The points this event granted for the order.

debtRepaid.description: How much of `points` repaid an existing debt before any new lot was created.

available.description: The member's available balance after the change, computed from lots minus debt. A point-in-time value; a later event or a read of the member is newer. It is negative while a debt exceeds the unexpired lots.

debt.description: The member's debt after the change, to be repaid by the next earn.
